sides.description: 1: against a wall, front facing +Z; 2: an island with a second face toward -Z

depth.description: depth of the shelf boards on each face; unit: m

levels.description: height of the top of each shelf board from the floor, bottom up; the first is the base

bay.description: spacing of the uprights (shelves, 1 when missing), the doors (fridges, 0.75) or the heat lamps (deli, 0.6); unit: m

frameColor.description: color of the frame and boards (sRGB #rrggbb)

boardThickness.description: thickness of the boards (wooden boards often have a 4 cm thick front); unit: m

boardColor.description: color of the boards (sRGB #rrggbb): wood-grain boards of this color; plain boards of the frame color when missing

font.description: font of the prices on the tags; plain tags without one; content path of a font asset (no extension)

items.description: content path of a product asset (no extension)

products.description: products to stock; each level only takes those that fit under the next board

variants.description: brands of each product (product variants: the colors and brand the product file leaves out)

facings.description: how many of one item stand side by side (min, max); [2, 5] on shelves, [3, 6] on stacks when missing

rows.description: at most this many rows deep (fewer when the board is shallower)

messiness.description: how messy the stock is: round bottles and jars turned (labels facing different ways), boxes tilted a little, some columns pushed back, small shifts within the gaps; 0 is factory tidy

items.description: content path of a product asset (no extension)

levels.description: products per level (from the bottom, like levels): a level only takes these (stores often keep one kind per level); missing or null levels use products

stock.description: what goes on the shelf; empty shelves without it

type.description: gondola: open shelves; fridge: one face behind glass doors with light strips and a lit header; freezer: a chest with goods lying in the well under sliding glass lids (depth is the whole width, only the first level is used: the well floor); pegboard: goods hanging on rows of hooks (levels are the hook rows, depth the hook length); stack: a floor display stacked in tapering blocks on a platform (only the first level is used: the platform top; depth is the stack depth; centered); deli: a black counter with a white quartz front ledge and rows of bowls and plates in a sunken black tray, gold heat lamps every bay above (only the first level is used: the tray top; height is the bottom of the lamp shades; depth is the whole counter); pallet: whole cases stacked straight up to the height on a wooden pallet, each layer a little off, some taken from the top; one kind of goods per pallet (only the first level is used: the pallet top; length and depth are the size of the load; centered; wood grain when boardColor is set)

header.description: text on the lit header of a fridge (needs the font)

doorColor.description: fridge: color of the door frames, the front below the doors, the top and the header box (sRGB #rrggbb; branded drink fridges are yellow, red...); dark frames and a blue header when missing

doorHaze.description: fridge: how smudged the door glass is (0..1, 0 spotless): fingerprints, palm marks and specks by the handle, a band of fog and droplets at the bottom; different on every door from the seed

title.description: text on the banner at the top of the sticker ("frozen zone"); needs font

slogan.description: text on the strip at the bottom of the sticker; needs font

border.description: width of the side borders; unit: m

doorSticker.description: fridge: an advertising sticker on the outside of every door glass, around the lower two thirds: a banner with a title, side borders and a strip with a slogan, the middle left clear

tagHolder.description: where the tags sit: on a strip below the board front (strip) or slid behind a clear plastic rail standing on the board front, leaning back a little (rail; no strip under the board)

tagAccent.description: color of a block on the right of paper tags (sRGB #rrggbb, the store color): all tags white with dark grey prices then; white or yellow with red prices when missing

priceTags.description: paper tags (white or yellow, red price) or electronic shelf labels (a small housing with an e-ink screen, black price and a QR code, some with a red promo bar)

height.description: height of the cabinet on top of the shelf; unit: m

depth.description: depth of the cabinet; the shelf depth when missing; unit: m

columns.description: cells per bay (the widths vary a little from the seed, each row on its own)

hex.description: tall hexagonal cells through all rows (pointed at half height on the left and right), placed by the seed

items.description: content path of a product asset (no extension)

products.description: bottles lying in the cells, neck out

fill.description: share of the cells that have bottles

cubbies.description: a wooden cubby cabinet on top of a gondola, bottles lying in the cells

seed.description: random seed of the stocking and the prices
